title: OrcaResolverBridgeErrorCodes
description: Error code registry for the Orca Design Mode to Hermes State Engine Resolver bridge. Contract IDD-016 v1.0.0. The four contract-mandated codes are STALE_NODE, ELEMENT_NOT_RESOLVABLE, RESOLVER_TIMEOUT, ACTION_REJECTED.

source.description: resolver: emitted by the state engine in the response envelope. caller_transport: synthesized by the Orca caller when the resolver cannot be reached at all.

http_status.description: HTTP status for the direct-call fallback. Null when the code never crosses HTTP.

retry_backoff_ms.description: Delay ladder in milliseconds, one entry per retry attempt.

caller_action.description: What the caller MUST do on this code.

codes.meaning: The requested backendDOMNodeId no longer exists in the live DOM of page.target_id, and structural fallback matching found no candidate at or above the confidence floor.
codes.caller_action: Recapture the element to obtain a fresh backendDOMNodeId. You may resend once as a NEW request_id. Do not blind-retry the same payload.

codes.meaning: No candidate reached the confidence floor of 0.5. The element is not resolvable on this page state.
codes.caller_action: Surface the failure to the Design Mode user with the candidate list in details. A human must pick again. Do not retry automatically.

codes.meaning: Resolution plus optional action execution exceeded the request timeout_ms budget.
codes.caller_action: Retry with the SAME request_id so the resolver replays the cached outcome instead of re-executing. Stop after 2 retries and surface the error.

codes.meaning: The resolved element cannot accept the requested action. reason_code gives the cause: confidence_below_policy, element_type_incompatible, known_bug_no_workaround, or element_not_interactable.
codes.caller_action: Do not retry the same action. Either change the action, apply the flagged known-bug workaround, or ask the user to confirm.

codes.meaning: The request payload failed schema validation. details.validation_errors lists every violation.
codes.caller_action: Fix the payload against orca-resolver-request.schema.json. Retrying an invalid payload always fails.

codes.meaning: The request schema_version major differs from the resolver's supported contract version.
codes.caller_action: Upgrade the caller to the resolver's contract version. Do not retry with the old payload.

codes.meaning: The resolver is not attached to page.target_id, and automatic attach failed because the target is closed or unreachable.
codes.caller_action: Confirm the tab is still open, then retry once with the same request_id after the resolver reattaches.

codes.meaning: Neither the MCP endpoint nor the HTTP fallback responded. Transport-level failure synthesized by the caller. The resolver never emits this code.
codes.caller_action: Retry the transport with the same request_id using the documented ladder. After the fourth failure, surface the error and stop.

codes.meaning: Unexpected resolver failure. The response carries resolver.version and the request_id for journal correlation.
codes.caller_action: Retry once with the same request_id. If it persists, file a state-engine issue with the request_id.
